replies.author: Administrafer
replies.body:
I asked you in-game who assassino was to you, and you replied with: "cousin". Bare in mind lying only diminishes your chances of being appealed; additionally we have recently stricken the policy of ban evading.

Last time, you will not be unbanned. Make another thread pertaining to your punishment will earn you a forum ban.
